Steering & trim

0.00
Forward bears away, aft points up. This is how a proa steers.
1.00
Hauled to the masthead cuts weather helm; eased, the yard falls and the boat wants to point up.
1.00
Tight holds the mast upright against the ama. Slack lets it fall to leeward, which turns the bow into the wind.
1.00
Fore-aft mast rake. Forward moves the sail’s pull ahead and bears away; aft points up. The main cure for weather helm.
